title: prunus ceylanica
intro: Prunus ceylanica, commonly known as Ceylon cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Sri Lanka, belonging to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Prunus ceylanica include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, improving heart health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Prunus ceylanica include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Prunus ceylanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
